verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for a note-taking SaaS, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents a setting to disable telemetry, analytics, or usage tracking. The AI-privacy statement (AI features are opt-in, and no space data goes to third-party AI services) is an adjacent control about AI data sharing, not usage telemetry, so it earns no credit.
